list.name: team
list.query:
SELECT __text, __value FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(wt.team_name, NULLIF(t.name, ''), '(unassigned)') AS __text, COALESCE(wt.team_name, NULLIF(t.name, ''), '(unassigned)') AS __value FROM whodunit_repos r LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = r.contributor LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = r.contributor
UNION SELECT '(unassigned)', '(unassigned)'
) options ORDER BY 1
list.label: Team

options.content:
How fast tasks close, whether the backlog is draining, and when

Tasks are tracker issues. Throughput is issues closed per week, and per person-week when the headcount that week is taken out — the figure that survives a team growing. Backlog is issues opened minus closed; it drains only when closing outruns opening, so every forecast here uses net flow, not throughput alone. Adoption is dated from the first week AI-assisted commits reached a quarter of all commits. The team and contributor filters apply to everything attributed through commits — per team, per person, per task; the org-level backlog and burn-up stay whole, because open issues carry no person yet.

Before and after adoption is a difference, not an effect. Team size, work mix and the release calendar changed too. Issues are counted, not sized — fifty small ones and five large ones look alike.

panels.title: Throughput multiple, per head
panels.description: Issues closed per person-week after adoption, divided by the same before. This is the honest form of 'nX faster': headcount is taken out, so a team that doubled does not read as twice as productive. Blank below 10 issues on either side. A difference between two periods, not an effect of the tool. Counts issues with linked commits, attributed to the people who made them, so the team and contributor filters apply; an issue with no linked commit is not counted here.

targets.rawSql:
WITH adopt AS (
  SELECT MIN(w) AS d FROM (
    SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1e9)) DAY) w,
           SUM(status='assisted')/COUNT(*) share
    FROM whodunit_commits GROUP BY w HAVING share >= 0.25) t),
cbp AS (
  SELECT i.id, DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY) w
  FROM issues i JOIN issue_commits ic ON ic.issue_id = i.id
  JOIN whodunit_commits c ON c.commit_sha = ic.commit_sha
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
  LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE i.status='DONE' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
    AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  GROUP BY i.id, w),
hw AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) DAY) w,
         COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)) n
  FROM whodunit_commits c
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
  LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
    AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  GROUP BY w),
cw AS (SELECT w, COUNT(*) n FROM cbp GROUP BY w),
s AS (SELECT CASE WHEN cw.w >= adopt.d THEN 'after' ELSE 'before' END side,
             SUM(cw.n)/NULLIF(SUM(hw.n),0) rate, SUM(cw.n) issues
      FROM cw JOIN hw ON hw.w = cw.w CROSS JOIN adopt GROUP BY side)
SELECT CASE WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN side='before' THEN issues END) >= 10 AND MIN(CASE WHEN side='after' THEN issues END) >= 10
            THEN ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN side='after' THEN rate END)/NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN side='before' THEN rate END),0),2) END AS value
FROM s

panels.title: Per person-week, before and after
panels.description: Issues closed divided by person-weeks — the sum over weeks of how many people committed that week. The per-head figure the multiple beside it is built from, with the raw counts behind it in the tooltip. Counts issues with linked commits, attributed to the people who made them, so the team and contributor filters apply; an issue with no linked commit is not counted here.

targets.rawSql:
WITH adopt AS (
  SELECT MIN(w) AS d FROM (
    SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1e9)) DAY) w,
           SUM(status='assisted')/COUNT(*) share
    FROM whodunit_commits GROUP BY w HAVING share >= 0.25) t),
cbp AS (
  SELECT i.id, DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY) w
  FROM issues i JOIN issue_commits ic ON ic.issue_id = i.id
  JOIN whodunit_commits c ON c.commit_sha = ic.commit_sha
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
  LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE i.status='DONE' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
    AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  GROUP BY i.id, w),
hw AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) DAY) w,
         COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)) n
  FROM whodunit_commits c
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
  LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
    AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  GROUP BY w),
cw AS (SELECT w, COUNT(*) n FROM cbp GROUP BY w)
SELECT CASE WHEN cw.w >= adopt.d THEN 'After adoption' ELSE 'Before adoption' END AS metric,
       ROUND(SUM(cw.n)/NULLIF(SUM(hw.n),0),2) AS `Issues closed per person-week`,
       SUM(cw.n) AS `Issues`, SUM(hw.n) AS `Person-weeks`
FROM cw JOIN hw ON hw.w = cw.w CROSS JOIN adopt GROUP BY metric ORDER BY metric

panels.title: Issues closed per week, with people committing
panels.description: Weekly closures as bars, with the number of people who committed that week as a line. Read them together: closures rising with headcount flat is throughput; rising with headcount is hiring. Counts issues with linked commits, attributed to the people who made them, so the team and contributor filters apply; an issue with no linked commit is not counted here.

targets.rawSql:
WITH adopt AS (
  SELECT MIN(w) AS d FROM (
    SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1e9)) DAY) w,
           SUM(status='assisted')/COUNT(*) share
    FROM whodunit_commits GROUP BY w HAVING share >= 0.25) t),
cbp AS (
  SELECT i.id, DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY) w
  FROM issues i JOIN issue_commits ic ON ic.issue_id = i.id
  JOIN whodunit_commits c ON c.commit_sha = ic.commit_sha
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
  LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE i.status='DONE' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
    AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  GROUP BY i.id, w),
hw AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) DAY) w,
         COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)) n
  FROM whodunit_commits c
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
  LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
    AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  GROUP BY w),
cw AS (SELECT w, COUNT(*) n FROM cbp GROUP BY w)
SELECT CAST(cw.w AS DATETIME) AS time, cw.n AS `Issues closed`, hw.n AS `People committing`
FROM cw LEFT JOIN hw ON hw.w = cw.w ORDER BY time

panels.title: Open backlog and net flow, per week
panels.description: Open backlog is everything opened minus everything closed, to that week. Net flow is that week's closed minus opened: above zero the backlog shrank, below it grew. A team can close a record number of issues in a week the backlog still grows.

targets.rawSql:
WITH o AS (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(i.created_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.created_date) DAY) w, COUNT(*) n FROM issues i WHERE i.created_date IS NOT NULL AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' GROUP BY w),
     c AS (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY) w, COUNT(*) n FROM issues i WHERE i.status='DONE' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' GROUP BY w),
     wk AS (SELECT w FROM o UNION SELECT w FROM c),
     cum AS (SELECT wk.w,
               SUM(COALESCE(o.n,0)) OVER (ORDER BY wk.w) opened_cum,
               SUM(COALESCE(c.n,0)) OVER (ORDER BY wk.w) closed_cum,
               COALESCE(o.n,0) opened, COALESCE(c.n,0) closed
             FROM wk LEFT JOIN o ON o.w = wk.w LEFT JOIN c ON c.w = wk.w)
SELECT CAST(w AS DATETIME) AS time, opened_cum - closed_cum AS `Open backlog`, closed - opened AS `Net flow`
FROM cum WHERE $__timeFilter(w) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Burn-up, with the projection
panels.description: Cumulative opened and closed. The dashed lines continue both at their last 8-week rates; where closed meets opened is the drain date. If the dashed lines never meet inside 26 weeks the backlog is not draining at the current rates.

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE
o AS (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(i.created_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.created_date) DAY) w, COUNT(*) n FROM issues i WHERE i.created_date IS NOT NULL AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' GROUP BY w),
c AS (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY) w, COUNT(*) n FROM issues i WHERE i.status='DONE' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' GROUP BY w),
wk AS (SELECT w FROM o UNION SELECT w FROM c),
cum AS (SELECT wk.w, SUM(COALESCE(o.n,0)) OVER (ORDER BY wk.w) oc, SUM(COALESCE(c.n,0)) OVER (ORDER BY wk.w) cc
        FROM wk LEFT JOIN o ON o.w = wk.w LEFT JOIN c ON c.w = wk.w),
last AS (SELECT MAX(w) w FROM cum),
-- The recursive member may not contain subqueries, so the rates are
-- computed once here and carried through the recursion as columns.
seed AS (SELECT last.w, cum.cc, cum.oc,
                (SELECT AVG(c.n) FROM c WHERE c.w > DATE_SUB(last.w, INTERVAL 8 WEEK)) cr,
                (SELECT AVG(o.n) FROM o WHERE o.w > DATE_SUB(last.w, INTERVAL 8 WEEK)) orate
         FROM last JOIN cum ON cum.w = last.w),
proj AS (SELECT 0 k, w, cc, oc, cr, orate FROM seed
         UNION ALL SELECT k+1, DATE_ADD(w, INTERVAL 1 WEEK), cc + cr, oc + orate, cr, orate
         FROM proj WHERE k < 26 AND cc < oc)
SELECT CAST(w AS DATETIME) AS time, oc AS `Opened, cumulative`, cc AS `Closed, cumulative`,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS `Closed, projected`, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS `Opened, projected`
FROM cum WHERE $__timeFilter(w)
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(w AS DATETIME), NULL, NULL, ROUND(cc), ROUND(oc) FROM proj WHERE k > 0
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Drain date under three rates
panels.description: Open issues now, divided by net flow — closing rate minus the recent opening rate — under three closing rates: what the team did before adoption, the last 8 weeks, and its best recent 4 weeks. 'Never at this rate' means issues arrive faster than that rate closes them. Assumes inflow continues as it has.

targets.rawSql:
WITH adopt AS (
  SELECT MIN(w) AS d FROM (
    SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1e9)) DAY) w,
           SUM(status='assisted')/COUNT(*) share
    FROM whodunit_commits GROUP BY w HAVING share >= 0.25) t),
o AS (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(i.created_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.created_date) DAY) w, COUNT(*) n FROM issues i WHERE i.created_date IS NOT NULL AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' GROUP BY w),
c AS (SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY) w, COUNT(*) n FROM issues i WHERE i.status='DONE' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' GROUP BY w),
last AS (SELECT MAX(w) w FROM c),
open_now AS (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues i WHERE i.status <> 'DONE' AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$'),
inflow AS (SELECT AVG(n) n FROM o, last WHERE o.w > DATE_SUB(last.w, INTERVAL 8 WEEK)),
rates AS (
  SELECT 'Pre-adoption throughput' scenario, 1 ord, (SELECT AVG(c.n) FROM c, adopt WHERE c.w < adopt.d) r
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Current, last 8 weeks', 2, (SELECT AVG(c.n) FROM c, last WHERE c.w > DATE_SUB(last.w, INTERVAL 8 WEEK))
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Best recent 4 weeks', 3, (SELECT MAX(s) FROM (SELECT AVG(n) OVER (ORDER BY w ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) s FROM c) t))
SELECT scenario AS `Rate`, ROUND(r,1) AS `Closed / week`, ROUND(inflow.n,1) AS `Opened / week`,
       ROUND(r - inflow.n,1) AS `Net / week`, open_now.n AS `Open now`,
       CASE WHEN r - inflow.n > 0 THEN CEIL(open_now.n/(r - inflow.n)) END AS `Weeks to drain`,
       CASE WHEN r - inflow.n > 0 THEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(last.w, INTERVAL CEIL(open_now.n/(r - inflow.n)) WEEK),'%b %e, %Y') ELSE 'never at this rate' END AS `Drains by`
FROM rates, inflow, open_now, last ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Issues closed per person-week, by team
panels.description: Each team's closed issues divided by its person-weeks, before and after adoption. An issue is attributed to the people whose commits are linked to it, and to their teams; one with committers on two teams counts for both. Blank means no closed, linked issues on that side.

targets.rawSql:
WITH adopt AS (
  SELECT MIN(w) AS d FROM (
    SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1e9)) DAY) w,
           SUM(status='assisted')/COUNT(*) share
    FROM whodunit_commits GROUP BY w HAVING share >= 0.25) t), 
cbp AS (
  SELECT i.id, DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY) w, i.resolution_date,
         COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) person,
         COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') team,
         COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9))) person_days
  FROM issues i JOIN issue_commits ic ON ic.issue_id = i.id
  JOIN whodunit_commits c ON c.commit_sha = ic.commit_sha
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
  LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE i.status='DONE' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
    AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  GROUP BY i.id, w, i.resolution_date, person, team), 
ht AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) DAY) w,
         COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') team, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)) n
  FROM whodunit_commits c
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
  LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
    AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  GROUP BY w, team),
cw AS (SELECT team, w, COUNT(DISTINCT id) n FROM cbp GROUP BY team, w)
SELECT cw.team AS metric,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cw.w <  adopt.d THEN cw.n END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cw.w <  adopt.d THEN ht.n END),0),2) AS `Before adoption`,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cw.w >= adopt.d THEN cw.n END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cw.w >= adopt.d THEN ht.n END),0),2) AS `After adoption`
FROM cw JOIN ht ON ht.w = cw.w AND ht.team = cw.team CROSS JOIN adopt
GROUP BY cw.team ORDER BY `After adoption` DESC

panels.title: Issues closed per week, by team
panels.description: Weekly closures per team, attributed through linked commits. Which team's throughput moved when adoption did, and which did not.

targets.rawSql:
WITH 
cbp AS (
  SELECT i.id, DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY) w, i.resolution_date,
         COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) person,
         COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') team,
         COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9))) person_days
  FROM issues i JOIN issue_commits ic ON ic.issue_id = i.id
  JOIN whodunit_commits c ON c.commit_sha = ic.commit_sha
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
  LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE i.status='DONE' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
    AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  GROUP BY i.id, w, i.resolution_date, person, team)
SELECT CAST(w AS DATETIME) AS time, team AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS value
FROM cbp GROUP BY w, team ORDER BY time, team

panels.title: Drain date by team
panels.description: Open issues per team by tracker assignee, against that team's closing and opening rates over the last 8 weeks. The (unassigned) row is every open issue with no assignee — usually most of them — and is the honest size of what cannot be forecast per team until the tracker assigns work. 'Never at this rate' means the team's inflow outruns its closing.

targets.rawSql:
WITH adopt AS (
  SELECT MIN(w) AS d FROM (
    SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1e9)) DAY) w,
           SUM(status='assisted')/COUNT(*) share
    FROM whodunit_commits GROUP BY w HAVING share >= 0.25) t),
tm AS (SELECT i.id, i.status, i.created_date, i.resolution_date,
              COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(i.assignee_name,'')='' THEN '(unassigned)' ELSE '(unassigned)' END) team
       FROM issues i
       LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = i.assignee_name
       LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, i.assignee_name)
       LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
       LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, i.assignee_name)
       WHERE i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$'
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')),
last AS (SELECT MAX(DATE_SUB(DATE(resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(resolution_date) DAY)) w FROM tm WHERE status='DONE'),
c8 AS (SELECT team, COUNT(*)/8 r FROM tm, last WHERE status='DONE' AND resolution_date > DATE_SUB(last.w, INTERVAL 8 WEEK) GROUP BY team),
o8 AS (SELECT team, COUNT(*)/8 r FROM tm, last WHERE created_date > DATE_SUB(last.w, INTERVAL 8 WEEK) GROUP BY team),
op AS (SELECT team, COUNT(*) n FROM tm WHERE status <> 'DONE' GROUP BY team)
SELECT op.team AS `Team`, op.n AS `Open now`,
       ROUND(COALESCE(c8.r,0),1) AS `Closed / week`, ROUND(COALESCE(o8.r,0),1) AS `Opened / week`,
       ROUND(COALESCE(c8.r,0)-COALESCE(o8.r,0),1) AS `Net / week`,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(c8.r,0)-COALESCE(o8.r,0) > 0 THEN CEIL(op.n/(c8.r-COALESCE(o8.r,0))) END AS `Weeks to drain`,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(c8.r,0)-COALESCE(o8.r,0) > 0
            THEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(last.w, INTERVAL CEIL(op.n/(c8.r-COALESCE(o8.r,0))) WEEK),'%b %e, %Y')
            ELSE 'never at this rate' END AS `Drains by`
FROM op LEFT JOIN c8 ON c8.team = op.team LEFT JOIN o8 ON o8.team = op.team CROSS JOIN last
ORDER BY op.team = '(unassigned)', op.n DESC

panels.title: Tasks closed per person, before and after
panels.description: Per person: tasks closed in range, tasks per person-day of committing, weekly rate before and after adoption, and the multiple where both sides have 5 or more. Attribution through linked commits. A multiple is a difference in that person's two periods, not an effect; someone who joined after adoption has no before.

targets.rawSql:
WITH adopt AS (
  SELECT MIN(w) AS d FROM (
    SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1e9)) DAY) w,
           SUM(status='assisted')/COUNT(*) share
    FROM whodunit_commits GROUP BY w HAVING share >= 0.25) t), 
cbp AS (
  SELECT i.id, DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY) w, i.resolution_date,
         COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) person,
         COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') team,
         COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9))) person_days
  FROM issues i JOIN issue_commits ic ON ic.issue_id = i.id
  JOIN whodunit_commits c ON c.commit_sha = ic.commit_sha
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
  LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE i.status='DONE' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
    AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  GROUP BY i.id, w, i.resolution_date, person, team),
pw AS (SELECT person, team, w, COUNT(DISTINCT id) n, SUM(person_days) pd FROM cbp GROUP BY person, team, w),
agg AS (SELECT person, team,
          SUM(n) tasks, SUM(pd) pd,
          SUM(CASE WHEN w <  adopt.d THEN n END) nb, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w <  adopt.d THEN w END) wb,
          SUM(CASE WHEN w >= adopt.d THEN n END) na, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w >= adopt.d THEN w END) wa
        FROM pw CROSS JOIN adopt GROUP BY person, team)
SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(person,'@',1) AS `Person`, team AS `Team`, tasks AS `Tasks closed`,
       ROUND(tasks/NULLIF(pd,0),2) AS `Tasks per person-day`,
       ROUND(nb/NULLIF(wb,0),2) AS `Per week, before`, ROUND(na/NULLIF(wa,0),2) AS `Per week, after`,
       CASE WHEN nb >= 5 AND na >= 5 THEN ROUND((na/NULLIF(wa,0))/NULLIF(nb/NULLIF(wb,0),0),2) END AS `Multiple`
FROM agg ORDER BY `Tasks per person-day` DESC

panels.title: Tasks per person-day, by person
panels.description: Tasks closed divided by the person-days of committing behind them, per person, at least 3 tasks. Throughput per unit of effort, not a ranking of people: the work each person is handed differs, and the page cannot see that.

targets.rawSql:
WITH 
cbp AS (
  SELECT i.id, DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY) w, i.resolution_date,
         COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) person,
         COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') team,
         COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9))) person_days
  FROM issues i JOIN issue_commits ic ON ic.issue_id = i.id
  JOIN whodunit_commits c ON c.commit_sha = ic.commit_sha
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
  LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE i.status='DONE' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
    AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  GROUP BY i.id, w, i.resolution_date, person, team)
SELECT CONCAT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(person,'@',1),' · ',team) AS metric,
       ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT id)/NULLIF(SUM(person_days),0),2) AS value
FROM cbp GROUP BY person, team HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT id) >= 3 ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Effort and elapsed time per task, AI-assisted against not AI-assisted
panels.description: For closed issues with linked commits: commits, lines, person-days of committing, and hours from opened to resolved, averaged per task, split by whether any linked commit was AI-assisted. Tasks per person-day is the throughput form. Difference, not effect: which tasks got the agent was chosen, not assigned. Blank below 5 tasks a side.

targets.rawSql:
WITH iss AS (
  SELECT i.id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, i.created_date, i.resolution_date) hrs,
         MAX(c.status='assisted') ai, COUNT(c.commit_sha) commits,
         SUM(c.lines_added + c.lines_removed) total_lines,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.contributor, DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9))) person_days
  FROM issues i JOIN issue_commits ic ON ic.issue_id = i.id
  JOIN whodunit_commits c ON c.commit_sha = ic.commit_sha
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
  LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE i.status='DONE' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
    AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
    AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  GROUP BY i.id, hrs),
s AS (SELECT ai, COUNT(*) n, AVG(commits) commits, AVG(total_lines) total_lines, AVG(person_days) pd, AVG(hrs) hrs FROM iss GROUP BY ai),
n AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ai=1 THEN n END) na, MAX(CASE WHEN ai=0 THEN n END) nu FROM s)
SELECT m.metric AS `Per task`, m.a AS `AI-assisted`, m.u AS `Not AI-assisted`,
       CASE WHEN n.na >= 5 AND n.nu >= 5 AND m.u > 0 THEN ROUND(100*(m.a-m.u)/m.u,0) END AS `Difference %`,
       CONCAT(n.na,' / ',n.nu) AS `n`
FROM (
  SELECT 'Commits per task' metric, 1 o, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN ai=1 THEN commits END),1) a, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN ai=0 THEN commits END),1) u FROM s
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Lines per task', 2, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN ai=1 THEN total_lines END)), ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN ai=0 THEN total_lines END)) FROM s
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Person-days per task', 3, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN ai=1 THEN pd END),1), ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN ai=0 THEN pd END),1) FROM s
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Hours open per task', 4, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN ai=1 THEN hrs END)), ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN ai=0 THEN hrs END)) FROM s
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Tasks per person-day', 5, ROUND(1/NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN ai=1 THEN pd END),0),2), ROUND(1/NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN ai=0 THEN pd END),0),2) FROM s
) m CROSS JOIN n ORDER BY m.o

panels.title: Tasks closed per person-day, per week
panels.description: Each week: tasks closed divided by the person-days of committing behind them, assisted and not. The per-task productivity figure over time. A week is shown when either side has 3 or more tasks.

targets.rawSql:
WITH iss AS (
  SELECT i.id, DATE_SUB(DATE(i.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(i.resolution_date) DAY) w, MAX(c.status='assisted') ai,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.contributor, DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9))) person_days
  FROM issues i JOIN issue_commits ic ON ic.issue_id = i.id
  JOIN whodunit_commits c ON c.commit_sha = ic.commit_sha
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
  LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE i.status='DONE' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
    AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
    AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
  GROUP BY i.id, w)
SELECT CAST(w AS DATETIME) AS time,
       ROUND(SUM(ai=1)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ai=1 THEN person_days END),0),2) AS `AI-assisted`,
       ROUND(SUM(ai=0)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ai=0 THEN person_days END),0),2) AS `Not AI-assisted`
FROM iss GROUP BY w HAVING SUM(ai=1) >= 3 OR SUM(ai=0) >= 3 ORDER BY time

options.content: What the forecast assumes. That issues keep arriving at the recent 8-week rate and close at the chosen rate, every week, with no holidays, incidents or scope changes. A drain date is the date under those assumptions, not a commitment. Per-task figures need at least 5 tasks on each side and count an issue as assisted when any linked commit is; a task with no linked commits is not on this page at all.

target.rawSql:
WITH adopt AS (
  SELECT MIN(w) AS d FROM (
    SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1e9)) DAY) w,
           SUM(status='assisted')/COUNT(*) share
    FROM whodunit_commits GROUP BY w HAVING share >= 0.25) t) SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(d)*1000 AS time, 'AI adoption reached 25% of commits' AS text FROM adopt WHERE d IS NOT NULL
